rebuild.replacement: The script stages and validates the full matrix before replacing binaries/, and restores the prior directory if replacement validation fails.

gcc.rationale: Four generations with major-version labels 4, 8, 12, and 16; GCC 4.9 is the oldest selected compiler with working split-DWARF output on AArch64.

clang.rationale: Oldest and newest shells plus the nearest integer third points; major-version gaps are 6, 5, and 6.

reduced-ram.description: Reduce RAM usage at the cost of signing and key generation performance.

link.internal_relocations: Static symbol references are resolved. Compiler-generated local address tables may retain R_AARCH64_RELATIVE loader rebases.
link.dynamic_relocations: Every non-relative target is validated as undefined in the shared object.

debug.empty_units: Compiler-generated DWO files without .debug_info.dwo are omitted because they contain no compilation unit.
debug.duplicate_dwo_ids: Byte-identical duplicate DWO IDs from repeated multilevel translation units are deduplicated before packaging.

multilevel.description: Compile separate source files for all three parameter sets, archive every object, and final-link the complete archive into a shared object.
multilevel.compile_command: env CC=<cc> CFLAGS='-O<level> -g -gdwarf-4 -gsplit-dwarf -fPIC -fdebug-prefix-map=<root>=. <configuration-defines>' make -C examples/multilevel_build BUILD_DIR=<work>/objects AUTO=0 mldsa_objs -j2

multilevel-mono.description: Compile the single multilevel translation unit, archive it, and final-link the complete archive into a shared object.

checks_per_artifact: Shared object is AArch64 ET_DYN with SONAME libmldsa.so.
DF_SYMBOLIC is set and no dynamic TEXTREL is present.
No LOAD segment is both writable and executable.
Exactly the 42 public ML-DSA symbols are exported.
Every non-relative relocation targets an undefined symbol.
The matching example links and reports All tests passed!.
